tasks.notes: Found purging jubilee_w93729745 (2026-10-26, southampton-build cells 48,-44..49,-43). element_undo restored 36,756 of the build's 61,627 journalled positions (begin seq 90 -> undo seq 114); before-snapshot southampton_refine:before_jubilee_w93729745 (6208,37,-5535)-(6279,67,-5472) shows ground y~50-54 but live top_y at x=6244 z -5510..-5520 is 49 vs 54 (about 5 deep, z -5508..-5525); z -5500 and -5530 match. Unconfirmed cause: build excavation (zone levels 43/50/52) below ground not captured in the journal diff, so undo cannot reverse it. Plan: (1) reproduce on a feature with a lower floor level: scan the before_<plan> snapshot against the world after undo and list differing columns; (2) find why site_kit.undo skips them (journal records only changed vs ghost? strict flag?) and make undo restore from the before_<plan> structure for the whole begin box, or have apply journal excavated blocks; (3) add undo readback that compares the undone box with the snapshot and fails loudly on mismatch, since the current clean-readback check passed; (4) test in lib/site/test_element_undo.py; (5) have the purge skill's step 3 compare the footprint against the snapshot, not only reconcile.
